_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Dora Knowlton Ranous (1859-1916): the Marquis de Massa's Zibeline and D'Annunzio's The Flame (1906). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 23); Adam may veto. No uids minted.

_excluded.zibeline-volumes: Zibeline's three Gutenberg volume files are left out; the complete text (3934) is used.

_name_words_note: Translator name only: fetch_shelf.py treats it as the identity check, so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped).
